news.summary_zh: 據知情人士透露，Skydance Corp. 和 Walt Disney Co. 旗下的 ESPN 已拒絕競標下一屆 FIFA 男子世界盃賽事的美國媒體版權，這可能是全球足球賽事歷史上最昂貴且競爭最激烈的拍賣之一。

news.title: Josh Brown Says Netflix Trades at 16 Times Next Year’s Earnings After a 50% Drop. Is It a Buy?
news.summary: Josh Brown once called Netflix his biggest mistake of the year, then watched the stock sink even further. Now he sees a bargain hiding in the wreckage, but the bear case has real teeth, and one upcoming report could settle the debate.
news.title_zh: Josh Brown 指出 Netflix 交易價為 16 Times 倍明年盈利，此前下跌 50%。是否值得買入？
news.summary_zh: Josh Brown 曾稱 Netflix 為他年度最大錯誤，隨後目睹股價進一步下挫。如今他看見殘局中藏著便宜貨，但空頭論點確有威力，即將到來的一份報告可能終結辯論。

news.title: Netflix Stock Just Closed Below $60 for the First Time Since August 2024. I'd Buy It Now.
news.summary: The streaming giant's shares have hit the price I said I'd pay. Is there a good reason to wait longer?
news.title_zh: Netflix 股價剛收盤跌破 $60，為自 August 2024 以來首次。我現在會買入。
news.summary_zh: 這家串流巨頭的股價已觸及我說會買入的價格。還有好的理由再等待嗎？

news.title: Inside Netflix’s Fight to Keep the Streaming Crown
news.summary: Emily Chang travels to Paris, Seoul and Los Angeles to explore Netflix's next chapter in the entertainment world. In conversations with Co-CEO Ted Sarandos and Hollywood stars Ben Affleck and Lily Collins, Chang probes the company's global strategy, AI ambitions and executive shakeups. (Source: Bloomberg)
news.title_zh: 深入 Netflix 為保住串流霸主地位而戰
news.summary_zh: Emily Chang 前往巴黎、首爾和洛杉磯，探索 Netflix 在娛樂界的下一章。在與聯席執行長 Ted Sarandos 以及好萊塢巨星 Ben Affleck 和 Lily Collins 的對話中，Chang 探究該公司的全球策略、AI 野心和高層變動。(來源: Bloomberg)

news.title: Netflix Just Hit a 52-Week Low. Where’s the Bottom?
news.summary: Netflix has shed nearly half its value from the peak, and ad cuts and a massive Warner Bros. bet are fueling the fear. Yet record buybacks and fat margins tell a different story, so which signal should investors trust?
news.title_zh: Netflix 剛觸及 52 週低點。底在哪裡？
news.summary_zh: Netflix 從高點已蒸發近半價值，廣告削減和大規模押注 Warner Bros. 正加劇恐慌。然而創紀錄回購和豐厚利潤率卻講述不同故事，投資人該信哪個訊號？

news.title: Disney Weighs a Free Disney+ Tier. Netflix’s $8.99 Ad Plan Has a Big Problem
news.summary: Key TakeawaysDisney beat estimates with $25. 95 billion of fiscal fourth-quarter revenue and said again that it is exploring a free, ad-supported version of Disney+.
news.title_zh: Disney 權衡免費 Disney+ 方案。Netflix 的 $8.99 廣告方案有大問題
news.summary_zh: 重點Disney 擊敗預估，達 $25。95 billion 財年第四季營收，並再次表示正探索免費、廣告支持版 Disney+。

news.title: Why Did ASTS, NFLX, RCAT Stocks Plunge To 52-Week Lows Today?
news.summary: Operational challenges and setbacks weighed on investor confidence across space, streaming and defense stocks.
news.title_zh: 為何 ASTS、NFLX、RCAT 股價今日暴跌至 52 週低點？
news.summary_zh: 營運挑戰和挫折拖累太空、串流和防禦類股的投資人信心。

news.title: U.S. banks have another strong year in sight. But what could go wrong?
news.title_zh: 美國銀行展望另一個強勁年份。但可能出什麼問題？

news.title: Fed Eyes Bigger Hikes As Bond Market, Oil And Copper Signal Inflation Is Already Fading
news.summary: The Fed is talking about hiking more aggressively, into an economy it's already slowing and an inflation problem the market says is already fading.
news.title_zh: 聯準會關注更大幅度加息，因債券市場、石油與銅價顯示通膨已開始消退
news.summary_zh: 聯準會正討論更激進地加息，進入一個其已放緩的經濟，以及市場認為已開始消退的通膨問題。

news.title: Two More Days Above 5% and Treasury Yields Tie 2007’s Run
news.summary: The 10-year yield has spent four straight sessions above a line it rarely crosses, and a bond auction plus Fed minutes arrive within hours. Whether the streak survives could decide what happens next for long-bond holders.
news.title_zh: 再維持 5% 以上兩天，公債殖利率將追平 2007 的紀錄
news.summary_zh: 10 年期殖利率已連續四個交易日站上鮮少觸及的關鍵線，且債券拍賣與聯準會會議紀錄將在數小時內公布。這波連續漲勢能否延續，將決定長債持有者的後續走向。

news.title: Traders Now See a 95% Chance the Fed Hikes Rates in December
news.summary: A December hike looks like a lock, yet the Treasury market that matters most for long-bond holders answers to a different signal. Fed officials are split on how far this cycle runs, and TLT owners may be watching the wrong number.
news.title_zh: 交易員現在認為聯準會在十二月升息的機率為 95%
news.summary_zh: 十二月升息看起來鐵定會發生，但對長期債券持有者最重要的國債市場卻回應不同的訊號。聯準會官員對這輪循環能走多遠意見分歧，TLT 持有者可能正在關注錯誤的數字。

news.title: 2027 Macroeconomic Outlook: Testing The Limits Of Resilience
news.summary: From AI-led growth to attractive bond yields, 2027 could offer both broader opportunities and evolving risks for investors to navigate.
news.title_zh: 2027 宏觀經濟展望：考驗韌性極限
news.summary_zh: 從 AI 領導的成長到具吸引力的債券殖利率，2027 可能為投資者提供更廣泛的機會與不斷演變的風險以供導航。

news.title: Charting The Year Ahead: Investment Ideas For 2027
news.summary: As AI concentration reshapes markets, investors can find diversifying strategies to broaden opportunities while still seeking attractive returns.
news.title_zh: 展望來年：2027 投資構想
news.summary_zh: 隨著 AI 集中度重塑市場，投資人可尋找多元化策略擴大機會，同時仍追求吸引人報酬。

news.title: The Government Spends About $5.5 Billion a Day More Than It Takes In. The Debt Has Doubled in 10 Years. Jaime Dimon This the Situation Could Get Much Worse.
news.summary: Washington borrows over a trillion dollars a year just to pay interest on what it already owes, and two of Wall Street's most powerful executives are warning the pressure on bond markets has not yet reached its peak.
news.title_zh: 政府每天支出比收入多約 $5.5 Billion。債務在 10 年內翻倍。Jaime Dimon 認為情況可能會惡化得更嚴重。
news.summary_zh: 華盛頓每年借入超過一兆美元僅為支付現有債務利息，華爾街兩大權勢人物警告債券市場壓力尚未達到頂峰。

news.title: Bessent Tells the Fed Not to Hike “Too Much”
news.summary: Treasury wants the Fed to ease off while the officials who actually vote on rates lean the other way. Long-bond holders sit in the middle of that standoff, and two December dates could decide who wins.
news.title_zh: Bessent 告訴聯準會不要加息「太多」
news.summary_zh: 財政部希望聯準會緩手，而實際投票決定利率的官員則傾向相反方向。長期債券持有者處於這場對峙的中間，而十二月的兩個日期可能決定誰獲勝。

news.title: Kevin Warsh’s Fed Will Vote on Rates Only 7 Times in 2027
news.summary: The Fed is quietly trimming its meeting calendar, and long-term Treasuries already flinched. With a hike looming in December, fewer decision days could make every surprise hit bond holders harder. Which corner of the bond market gets hurt most?
news.title_zh: Kevin Warsh 的聯準會將僅在 2027 對利率投票 7 Times 次
news.summary_zh: 聯準會正悄悄縮減其會議行程，長期公債已有所反應。隨著十二月即將加息，較少的決策日可能使每個驚喜對債券持有者的衝擊更大。債券市場的哪個角落受損最重？

news.title: The U.S. Just Ran Its Biggest October Deficit Ever: $404 Billion
news.summary: A record October gap has a calendar quirk hiding the real story, and bond investors are already reacting. Why do long-dated Treasury funds feel the pain first, and what would prove the bearish case wrong by December?
news.title_zh: 美國剛錄得有史以來最大的十月赤字：$404 Billion
news.summary_zh: 創紀錄的十月缺口因行曆怪癖而掩蓋了真實故事，債券投資者已有反應。為何長期公債基金首當其衝感受痛苦，到十二月什麼情況能證明看空論點錯誤？

news.title: How Large Does Your Portfolio Need to Be to Generate $9,400 a Month?
news.summary: Six income holdings, one monthly paycheck target, and a stretch of the portfolio that could vanish in a merger. See which pick carries the shakiest check and which one quietly raises its payout every year.
news.title_zh: 您的投資組合需要多大才能每月產生 $9,400？
news.summary_zh: 六檔收益型持倉、一個月度薪資目標，以及一段可能因合併而消失的投資組合部分。看看哪一檔的支票最不穩固，哪一檔每年悄悄增加派息。

news.title: The Treasury Secretary Is Now Living on a Military Base After Iranian Threats
news.summary: Markets barely flinched when news broke that a cabinet secretary had moved onto a military base. Yet the quiet in oil and long bonds may hide a bigger risk for anyone holding USO or TLT, and a few scheduled events could expose it.
news.title_zh: 財政部長在伊朗威脅後現居住於軍事基地
news.summary_zh: 當內閣部長遷入軍事基地的消息傳出時，市場幾乎未受驚動。然而，原油與長期債券的平靜可能掩蓋著持有 USO 或 TLT 者的更大風險，且幾項既定事件可能揭露該風險。

news.title: Anthropic Shares Indicated to Open 25% Above IPO
news.summary: Anthropic shares are set to soar when they start trading on Thursday, after the AI lab’s $107.3 billion IPO and private placement broke SpaceX’s record for the biggest-ever offering. The company behind the Claude chatbot and its seven co-founders raised $81.3 billion in an IPO priced above range, topping SpaceX’s record for the biggest-ever first time share sale, and another $26 billion in a concurrent private placement. The deal values Anthropic at about $1.5 trillion on a fully diluted basis. The lineup of investors in Anthropic’s private placement is a who’s who of the AI trade, including Nvidia Alphabet’s Google, Microsoft and Advanced Micro Devices, according to its filings, a reflection of the tight relationships within the sector. Sarah Frier, Bloomberg Managing Editor for Technology Coverage, discusses Anthropic's bet on an enterprise use case for AI with Bloomberg's Paul Sweeney, Scarlet Fu, and John Tucker. (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title_zh: Elon Musk 表示 Tesla 和 SpaceX 「很可能」合併更好
news.summary_zh: Musk 暗示 Tesla 和 SpaceX 合併，但數學計算指向一組股東獲得較大公司的較小份額。哪一方握有槓桿，而 December 3 會議可能揭示什麼？

news.title: 4 Stocks Analysts and Hedge Funds Surprisingly Prefer Over Tesla
news.summary: Tesla keeps winning the headlines while its core profits shrink and its stock trades at a staggering multiple. Meanwhile, four quieter companies powering AI, advertising, and space are earning something Tesla can't: near-unanimous backing from the analysts and funds that watch them.
news.title_zh: 4 檔股票 分析師和對沖基金意外地更偏好於 Tesla
news.summary_zh: Tesla 持續佔據頭條，但其核心利潤卻在萎縮，股票卻以驚人的倍數交易。與此同時，四家在 AI、廣告和太空領域低調耕耘的公司，正贏得 Tesla 無法企及的東西：幾乎一致的分析師和基金看好。

news.title: Elon Musk Reportedly Says Tesla Will Continue To Increase Production In China – TSLA Stock Rises Premarket
news.summary: Musk met with Ren Hongbin, chairman of the China Council for the Promotion of International Trade, and pledged higher output from its biggest production hub, according to a Reuters report citing Chinese state media.
news.title_zh: 據報 Elon Musk 表示 Tesla 將繼續增加在中國的產量 – TSLA 股價盤前上漲
news.summary_zh: Musk 與中國國際貿易促進委員會會長任鴻斌會面，並承諾從其最大生產基地提高產量，據路透社報導引述中國官方媒體。

news.title: Tesla And SpaceX ‘Better Together’? Musk Leans Yes — But Says Performance Must Drive His TSLA Pay
news.summary: If a merger triggered a change in control, Tesla’s valuation alone would determine whether Musk earned additional shares.

news.summary_zh: 如果合併觸發控制權變更，僅 Tesla 的估值將決定馬斯克是否獲得額外股份。

news.title: Apple Has a Software Problem + Nvidia’s CEO Crisis with Joanna Stern
news.summary: In this episode of Power On, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman is joined by technology journalist and reviewer Joanna Stern of The New Things and NBC News for a critical look at Apple’s software leadership and its struggles to compete in artificial intelligence. They discuss whether software chief Craig Federighi’s management style and Apple’s rigid development processes are holding the company back, why Siri continues to fail at basic tasks and whether Apple needs to start over with a new AI assistant. They also examine how Apple’s AI shortcomings have delayed major hardware products. Plus, their experiences with the iPhone Duo, its new face-unlock feature, Joanna’s HomeView review and whether Apple’s Johny Srouji could be a candidate to lead Nvidia following its leadership crisis. Have a question for Mark? Email us at poweron@bloomberg.net or join the Power On Discord Subscribe to the Power On Newsletter at https://www.bloomberg.com/poweron (Source: Bloomberg)
news.title_zh: Apple 面臨軟體問題 + Nvidia CEO 危機，與 Joanna Stern 對談
news.summary_zh: 在這集 Power On 中，Bloomberg 的 Mark Gurman 與科技記者兼評論員 Joanna Stern（來自 The New Things 和 NBC News）一起，批判性地檢視 Apple 的軟體領導地位及其在人工智慧領域競爭的掙扎。他們討論軟體主管 Craig Federighi 的管理風格和 Apple 僵化的開發流程是否阻礙了公司發展，為什麼 Siri 持續在基本任務上失敗，以及 Apple 是否需要重新開始打造新的 AI 助理。他們還探討 Apple 的 AI 缺陷如何延遲了主要硬體產品。此外，他們分享 iPhone Duo 的體驗、其新的臉部解鎖功能、Joanna 的 HomeView 評測，以及 Apple 的 Johny Srouji 在 Nvidia 領導危機後是否可能成為領導候選人。有問題要問 Mark？請發郵件至 poweron@bloomberg.net 或加入 Power On Discord 訂閱 Power On Newsletter，網址：https://www.bloomberg.com/poweron (來源：Bloomberg)

items.title: Apple Has a Software Problem + Nvidia’s CEO Crisis with Joanna Stern
items.summary: In this episode of Power On, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman is joined by technology journalist and reviewer Joanna Stern of The New Things and NBC News for a critical look at Apple’s software leadership and its struggles to compete in artificial intelligence. They discuss whether software chief Craig Federighi’s management style and Apple’s rigid development processes are holding the company back, why Siri continues to fail at basic tasks and whether Apple needs to start over with a new AI assistant. They also examine how Apple’s AI shortcomings have delayed major hardware products. Plus, their experiences with the iPhone Duo, its new face-unlock feature, Joanna’s HomeView review and whether Apple’s Johny Srouji could be a candidate to lead Nvidia following its leadership crisis. news.title: Apple Has a Software Problem + Nvidia’s CEO Crisis with Joanna Stern
news.summary: In this episode of Power On, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman is joined by technology journalist and reviewer Joanna Stern of The New Things and NBC News for a critical look at Apple’s software leadership and its struggles to compete in artificial intelligence. They discuss whether software chief Craig Federighi’s management style and Apple’s rigid development processes are holding the company back, why Siri continues to fail at basic tasks and whether Apple needs to start over with a new AI assistant. They also examine how Apple’s AI shortcomings have delayed major hardware products. Plus, their experiences with the iPhone Duo, its new face-unlock feature, Joanna’s HomeView review and whether Apple’s Johny Srouji could be a candidate to lead Nvidia following its leadership crisis. Have a question for Mark? Email us at poweron@bloomberg.net or join the Power On Discord Subscribe to the Power On Newsletter at https://www.bloomberg.com/poweron (Source: Bloomberg)
news.title_zh: Apple 面臨軟體問題 + Nvidia CEO 危機，與 Joanna Stern 對談
news.summary_zh: 在這集 Power On 中，Bloomberg 的 Mark Gurman 與科技記者兼評論員 Joanna Stern（來自 The New Things 和 NBC News）一起，批判性地檢視 Apple 的軟體領導地位及其在人工智慧領域競爭的掙扎。他們討論軟體主管 Craig Federighi 的管理風格和 Apple 僵化的開發流程是否阻礙了公司發展，為什麼 Siri 持續在基本任務上失敗，以及 Apple 是否需要重新開始打造新的 AI 助理。他們還探討 Apple 的 AI 缺陷如何延遲了主要硬體產品。此外，他們分享 iPhone Duo 的體驗、其新的臉部解鎖功能、Joanna 的 HomeView 評測，以及 Apple 的 Johny Srouji 在 Nvidia 領導危機後是否可能成為領導候選人。有問題要問 Mark？請發郵件至 poweron@bloomberg.net 或加入 Power On Discord 訂閱 Power On Newsletter，網址：https://www.bloomberg.com/poweron (來源：Bloomberg)

news.title: Apple’s iPhone Camera and Photos Software Chief Jon McCormack Leaves Company
news.summary: Apple Inc.’s head of camera and photo software has left, marking a rare shake-up in the leadership behind one of the iPhone’s most important features.
news.title_zh: Apple iPhone 相機與照片軟體主管 Jon McCormack 離職
news.summary_zh: Apple Inc. 相機與照片軟體負責人已離職，標誌著 iPhone 最重要功能之一的領導層罕見變動。

news.title: Apple’s Longest-Serving Director Just Cashed Out $32 Million
news.summary: A 75-year-old director unloaded stock near Apple's record high, and the filing leaves out the one detail investors want most. Before you read it as a warning, check what the form actually shows and what it hides.
news.title_zh: 蘋果任職最久董事剛剛套現 $32 Million
news.summary_zh: 一位 75 歲的董事在蘋果股價創歷史新高附近拋售股票，且申報文件缺少投資者最想知道的細節。在將其視為警訊前，請查看表單實際顯示和隱藏的內容。

news.title: UK loses bid to keep Apple ‘backdoor’ order secret

news.summary_zh: 隱私權倡導者讚譽這是「問責、透明度和線上安全的重大勝利」

news.title: If Apple Reaches $400, Your $5,000 Investment Would Be Worth This Much
news.summary: Apple is up nearly 30% this year, yet analysts price it below today's level while a valuation model sees a far brighter path. Three earnings drivers and a few stubborn risks decide who is right.
news.title_zh: 若 Apple 達到 $400，您的 $5,000 投資將值這個數
news.summary_zh: Apple 今年上漲近 30%，但分析師目標價低於當前水位，估值模型卻看好後市。三大獲利驅動因素與幾項頑固風險將決定誰是對的。

news.title: Why Microsoft’s Stickier Revenue Gives It the Edge Over Apple Heading Into 2027
news.summary: Apple just posted a record quarter in John Ternus's CEO debut, while Microsoft quietly stacked up a contracted backlog that dwarfs it. One company faces memory costs and the other faces a massive spending bill, so which revenue base holds up better?
news.title_zh: 為何微軟較黏著的營收使其在進入 2027 時比蘋果更具優勢
news.summary_zh: 蘋果剛在 John Ternus 首次以 CEO 身分亮相時公布創紀錄季度，而微軟悄悄累積了遠超蘋果的合約積壓。一家公司面臨記憶體成本，另一家面臨龐大支出帳單，哪家營收基礎更能撐住？

news.title: Apple Became a Top Buffett Holding for a Reason. I'd Buy It With $1,000 Now.
news.summary: Apple closed its best fiscal year ever, and Berkshire Hathaway's new CEO still counts it among core holdings. Here's why I own the stock and will probably always like it.
news.title_zh: Apple 成為巴菲特重倉股有其原因。我會趁著 $1,000 現在買入。
news.summary_zh: Apple 結束了有史以來最好的財政年度，而 Berkshire Hathaway 的新任 CEO 仍將其視為核心持股。這就是我持有該股票並可能永遠看好它的原因。

news.title: Can Apple Grow Cash Flow 17% a Year? That’s What Its Record Price Implies
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOne investor’s reverse DCF finds Apple’s near-record price needs 16. 9% annual free cash flow growth for 10 years, three times its five-year revenue growth.
news.title_zh: Apple 能否每年讓現金流增長 17%？其創紀價格暗示了這一點
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點：一位投資者的反向 DCF 發現，Apple 近期的創紀價格需要 16。連續 10 年實現 9% 的年度自由現金流增長，是其五年營收增長的三倍。

news.title: Josh Brown: “No Greater Beneficiary Than Apple” if Nvidia Stops Hoarding Memory. Nvidia Just Did the Opposite
news.summary: Key TakeawaysNvidia’s supply commitments rose $111 billion to $390 billion, mostly on memory. Josh Brown says Apple gains most if Nvidia buys less memory.
news.title_zh: Josh Brown：「若 Nvidia 停止囤積記憶體，沒有比 Apple 更大的受益者」。Nvidia 剛做了相反的事
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點：Nvidia 的供應承諾增加了 $111 billion to $390 billion，主要集中在記憶體上。Josh Brown 說如果 Nvidia 減少購買記憶體，Apple 獲益最大。

news.title: Alphabet vs. Apple: Which Warren Buffett Stock Is the Better Buy?
news.summary: Both are major positions in the Berkshire Hathaway portfolio.
news.title_zh: Alphabet 對決 Apple：哪檔 Warren Buffett 股票是更好的買入選擇？
news.summary_zh: 兩者都是 Berkshire Hathaway 投資組合中的主要持倉。

Here is what a public price changes: each $1 move in ANT is about $1.8 billion to Alphabet, and last quarter's SpaceX loss shows where it lands.

news.title: Marvell And Intel Halved: How Long Until They Recover?
news.summary: Marvell and Intel have both lost more than half their value since June. At Tuesday's close on Nov 17, Marvell stood at $148.74. That is 53.0% below its high close of $316.43 on June 4. Intel closed at $55.17, 60.9% below its June 22 high. Most talk about the chip selloff is a buy-the-dip call or a warning that the AI trade is over. This article asks a narrower question. When a chip stock halves, how often does it get back to its high, and how long does it take.
news.title_zh: Marvell 和 Intel 腰斬：多久才能回升？
news.summary_zh: 自六月以來，Marvell 和 Intel 都已損失超過一半價值。在 Nov 17 星期二收盤時，Marvell 報 $148.74。這比其在 June 4 的高點收盤價 $316.43 低 53.0%。Intel 收於 $55.17，比其 June 22 高點低 60.9%。關於晶片股拋售的大多數論調要么是逢低買入的呼籲，要么是 AI 交易結束的警告。本文探討一個更窄的問題：當晶片股腰斬時，有多大機率能回到高點，以及需要多久時間。

news.title: Lumentum Is Down 33% in a Month as Marvell’s Slide Shrinks Its Buyout Value. Can LITE Stock Get Back to Bernstein’s $700 Target?

news.title: NuScale Sinks 22% in a Week to a 52-Week Low as Canada’s First SMR Runs Late. Is the Selling Overdone?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysNuScale fell 22% in a week to a 52-week low after Canada’s first GE Vernova Hitachi small modular reactor ran late and over budget. Oklo fell too, but NuScale, still without a binding module order, fell about twice as much.

news.title: Meta’s Prepayment Is Buying Oklo’s Nuclear Fuel for Up to Five Reactors
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOklo (OKLO) signed definitive agreements with Centrus Energy (LEU) on November 12 to secure enough nuclear fuel for up to five Aurora powerhouses, with deliveries starting in 2029. Meta Platforms (META) is helping finance fuel purchases for Oklo’s planned 1.

news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點Oklo (OKLO) 於 November 12 與 Centrus Energy (LEU) 簽署最終協議，確保最多五座 Aurora 發電廠所需的核燃料，交付將於 2029 開始。Meta Platforms (META) 正在協助為 Oklo 計劃的 1 融資採購燃料。

news.title: Oklo Sits Near Its 52-Week Low After a 5-Reactor Fuel Deal. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?

news.title_zh: Oklo 處於其 52 週低點附近，在 5 反應爐燃料交易後。是賣出還是加碼時機？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 Oklo 與 Centrus Energy 簽署最終合約，取得足夠 HALEU 燃料最多運轉五座 Aurora 電廠，交貨自 2029 開始。Meta 為未來電力預付款支持採購，Centrus 現計有 $5。

news.title: Oklo Has Lost 76% in a Year. Wall Street Still Sees $56. Bullish Wedbush Sees Just $36
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOklo has lost 76% in a year, and analysts’ average price target has fallen from $103 to $56. Wedbush repeated its Outperform rating and $36 target on Nov.

news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點Oklo 一年虧損 76%，分析師平均目標價已從 $103 to $56 下調。Wedbush 重申其跑贏大盤評級及 $36 目標價，於十一月。

news.title: AMD Soars 6%, Broadcom Up 6% as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Exits
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAMD shares jumped 6% after Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia’s CEO, and Broadcom rose with it. IonQ, SoundHound and Oklo fell instead, as investors cut back on the riskiest AI bets.

news.title: Craig-Hallum Just Cut Its Oklo Target From $53 to $27 After a Better-Than-Expected Quarter
news.summary: Key TakeawaysCraig-Hallum cut its Oklo price target to $27 from $53 on Nov. 9 and kept its Hold rating, three days after Oklo reported a narrower third-quarter loss than expected.

news.summary_zh: DOE 的運營限制許可將允許反應爐進入研究、測試和訓練階段。

news.title: Oklo Rises 4% as DOE Clears Groves-1 Reactor for Unrestricted Operations: “Reset the Nuclear Industry’s Expectations”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOklo shares jumped 4% today after the Department of Energy cleared its Groves-1 test reactor for unrestricted operations. Groves-1 shows Oklo can build fast, but it still needs a cost for its first Aurora powerhouse and a binding customer.
news.title_zh: Oklo 上漲 4%，因 DOE 核准 Groves-1 反應爐進行無限制運營：「重設核能產業期望」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Oklo 股價今日跳升 4%，因能源部核准其 Groves-1 試驗反應爐進行無限制運營。Groves-1 顯示 Oklo 能快速建設，但仍需首座 Aurora 電廠的成本和具約束力的客戶。

news.title: Oklo Receives DOE Clearance for Groves-1 Reactor Research, Testing and Training Operations
news.summary: Oklo Inc. (NYSE:OKLO) announced that the US Department of Energy (DOE) has cleared the final operations hold point for its Groves Isotope Test Reactor (Groves-1) in Lockhart, Texas, allowing the facility to proceed with research, testing and personnel training activities.
news.title_zh: Oklo 獲得 DOE 批准 Groves-1 反應爐研究、測試和培訓運營

news.title: Oklo Soars 14% in a Week on a Narrower Loss and a Deal for 27 Reactors’ Worth of Forgings

news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Oklo 股價在截至 Nov. 9 的一週內上漲 14%，得益於第三季虧損收窄和 27 反應堆的鍛件交易。
